Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements Your last action was a critically failed Strike.

Though one of your heads is primarily responsible for your body, the second can exert control some of the time—especially when they see your primary head make a mistake. You Strike with a different weapon or unarmed attack, and your multiple attack penalty for this attack is –3 (–2 with an agile attack) on your second attack of the turn instead of –5, and –6 (–4 with an agile attack) on your third or subsequent attack of the turn, instead of –10.
